title: UpliftMem: Learning Set-Level Uplift for Agent Memory Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2609.36805v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents reuse external memory to guide new tasks, but effective retrieval requires learning which memory sets improve execution. Such learning relies on costly outcome feedback: ordinary retrieval observes only executed sets, while evaluating alternatives requires additional rollouts. We introduce \textsc{UpliftMem}, which learns memory retrieval from set-level execution uplift relative to the same executor without memory. A theoretical analysis of how retrieval preferences restrict feedback coverage motivates targeted probing of alternative memory sets. Probe selection follows an expected value of sample information (EVSI) criterion, derived in closed form under a correlated Gaussian model, to allocate limited training rollouts according to their expected improvement in local retrieval decisions. The shared scorer is trained with a frozen executor and selects memory sets without test-time probes. Across ALFWorl

translated_title: UpliftMem：面向智能体记忆检索的集合级提升学习
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体通过复用外部记忆来指导新任务，但有效的检索需要学习哪些记忆集合能够改善执行效果。这类学习依赖代价高昂的结果反馈：普通检索只能观察到实际被执行的记忆集合，而评估其他备选集合则需要额外的推演。我们提出 UpliftMem，它以同一执行器在无记忆情况下的表现为基准，从集合级的执行提升中学习记忆检索。对检索偏好如何限制反馈覆盖范围的理论分析，启发了对备选记忆集合进行有针对性探测的方法。探测集合的选择遵循样本信息期望价值（EVSI）准则，该准则在相关高斯模型下以闭式形式推导得出，可根据各备选集合对局部检索决策的预期改进来分配有限的训练推演资源。共享的评分器在冻结执行器的条件下进行训练，在测试时无需探测即可直接选择记忆集合。在 ALFWorld 等基准上……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出 UpliftMem，以记忆集合相对无记忆执行器带来的集合级执行提升为学习信号，并利用闭式推导的 EVSI 准则分配有限的探测式推演，训练出无需测试时探测即可选出最优记忆集合的共享评分器。
en_tdlr: UpliftMem learns agent memory retrieval from set-level execution uplift relative to a memory-free executor, using a closed-form EVSI criterion to allocate probing rollouts and train a shared scorer that selects memory sets without test-time probes.
